items.name: Dak-Galbi Chicken Stew Set
items.description: Dak-Galbi Chicken Stew is a hearty, comforting Korean dish that brings bold flavors and satisfying textures to the table. The tender chicken pieces are simmered in a rich, spicy gochujang-based broth, creating a thick, flavourful stew with a satisfying balance of heat, sweetness, and umami.

items.name: Bombay Butter Chicken Stew
items.description: This succulent chicken in creamy, spiced butter sauce made with cumin, fenugreek, and cashew nuts served with our three-grain rice will instantly take you to Bombay without taking a plane.

items.name: Braised Beef Brisket Stew Set
items.description: A robust flavoured braised beef brisket prepared with golden brown onions, rosemary and thyme. Served with homemade mash potatoes!

items.name: Oriental Black Pepper Chicken Stew Set
items.description: Tender pieces of stir fried chicken bites stewed in a rich black pepper sauce with a hint of fragrance and sweetness from garlic, shallots and onions. Stew is served with special three-grain rice.

items.name: Thai Red Curry Chicken Stew Set
items.description: Diced chicken simmered in Thai red curry infused with authentic Thai spices including lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal and peppercorns. Mildly spicy.

items.name: Korean Spicy Chicken Stew Set
items.description: Chicken thigh meat slowly simmered in a Korean stew mix featuring onions, garlic, honey sesame oil, light soy sauce and Korean Pepper for that addictive fiery taste!

items.name: Mala Chicken Popiah
items.description: Mala Chicken Popiah contains succulent, bite-sized chicken pieces that is cooked with fragrant Sichuan spices and numbing Sichuan peppercorns for that signature mala kick. Served cold, this popiah is refreshing yet fiery—a satisfying contrast of cool, crisp vegetables and spicy, aromatic chicken.

items.name: Limited edition Laksa Aioli Popiah - National Day Special
items.description: Souperstar chicken popiah served with a twist of rich local laksa aioli dressing, bursting with sweet, coconutty with a mild spicy kick to it.

items.name: Chargrilled Teriyaki Chicken Popiah
items.description:
Popiah skin - made fresh daily! Chef Special! The most popular Japanese chicken - now in a Popiah version! Smokey chargrilled tender chicken thigh drenched in an aromatic teriyaki sauce and drizzle with a light hint of mayo for a true burst of Japanese Flavour!
 *Served Chilled*

items.name: Masala Chicken Popiah
items.description:
Popiah skin - made fresh daily! Chef Special! Chicken Masala, Paneer cheese, Crispy Curry Leaves, Crispy bits, Red Onion, Mixed lettuce, Shredded cucumbers.
 *Served Chilled*

items.name: Traditional Popiah
items.description: Handmade popiah skin - made fresh daily! Sweet sauce, minced garlic, sambal (contains shrimp), crispy bits, chopped peanuts, eggs, shredded cucumber, cilantro, slow-cooked turnips and carrots.

items.name: Sesame Chicken Popiah
items.description:
With 100% handmade popiah skin - made fresh daily! Roasted chicken, cherry tomatoes, mixed lettuce, red onion, shredded cucumber, crispy bits, creamy white sesame sauce.
 *Served Chilled*

items.name: Sweet Thai Chicken Popiah
items.description:
With 100% handmade popiah skin - made fresh daily! Roasted chicken, fresh mango, cherry tomatoes, cilantro, mixed lettuce, red onion, shredded cucumber, crispy bits, sweet Thai chilli mayonnaise.
 *Served Chilled*

items.name: Seafood Wasabi Mayo Popiah
items.description:
Popiah skin - made fresh daily! Fresh shrimp, seasoned tuna, and crab sticks, wakame seaweed, cherry tomatoes, mixed lettuce, red onion, shredded cucumber, crispy bits, light wasabi mayonnaise.
 *Served Chilled*

items.name: Sunny Carrot
items.description: A thick and creamy soup made of red carrots that were sauteed with thyme, homemade broth and cream. Garnished with tortilla for that cripsy crunch!

items.name: Creamy Thai Tom Yum
items.description: A harmonic blend of savoury, spice and creaminess, loaded with roasted chicken and prawns - the Land Of Smiles in a bowl!

items.name: Souper Shroomy
items.description: Most popular. Meat free, button mushrooms - chopped, seared and stirred in with cream and fragrant garlic and onion. Soup is then pureed for a creamy slurp! Soup broth contains garlic and onion.

items.name: Creamy Tomato Basil
items.description: Meat free, creamy blend of crushed tomatoes with sweet basil for a rich and zesty flavoured tomato soup. Soup broth contains garlic and onion.

items.name: Classic French Onion
items.description: Most popular. Meat free, no cream. Caramelized onions simmered with herbs for a sweet and savory flavour. Served with buttery cheese crouton. Soup broth contains garlic and onion.

items.name: Boston Clam Chowder
items.description: Premium. Thick and creamy soup made of blended juicy clams boiled with diced potatoes, carrot and celery. Soup broth contains garlic and onion. Image is for illustration purpose only.

items.name: Roasted Cauliflower Soup
items.description: Roasted Cauliflower Soup is a creamy, comforting dish that highlights the deep, nutty flavour of caramelized cauliflower.

items.name: Hearty Pumpkin
items.description: We’re bringing back your favourite – Festive Hearty Pumpkin soup! Light, creamy & flavourful – a perfect balance between comfort and festivity.

items.name: Double-up Potato & Turkey Bacon
items.description: Creamy soup made from two types of potatoes! Mashed potatoes and diced potatoes simmered with cream and Turkey Bacon slices.

items.name: Aburi Miso Salmon Salad
items.description: Fresh Pacific salmon, marinated with miso glaze & lightly torched for that perfect texture! Served with a medley of vegetables and sesame dressing - oishi!

items.name: Japanese Seafood Salad
items.description: Wakame seaweed, marinated tuna, fresh shrimps, kani sticks, salad mix, cherry tomatoes, Japanese cucumber, red onion, lemony Japanese dressing.

items.name: Caesar Chicken Salad
items.description: Roasted Chicken, Parmesan Cheese, Romaine Lettuce, Cherry Tomatoes, Red Onion, Cheese Croutons, Caesar Dressing

items.name: Classic Roast Chicken Salad
items.description: Roasted chicken, sautéed mushrooms, salad mix, cherry tomatoes, Japanese cucumber, red onion, crispy tortilla, creamy sesame dressing.

items.name: Vegetarian Char-Grilled Salad
items.description: Char-grilled vegetables, sautéed mushrooms, chickpeas, salad mix, black olives, cherry tomatoes, Japanese cucumber, cheese croutons, balsamic honey drizzle, homemade pesto drizzle.

items.name: Garlic Focaccia
items.description: Two slices of lightly toasted focaccia bread, with a delightfully herby & buttery garlic spread - ideal with soup!
